name: bakeoff-firebase
description: The Firebase half of the bake-off: the CoordinationStore adapter, its harness for the SHARED conformance suite, and the demo fixture.

scripts.test: cd .. && scripts/emulator.sh 'scripts/run-tests.sh --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=600000 firebase/store.test.ts firebase/errors.test.ts firebase/scoping.test.ts firebase/concurrency.test.ts'
scripts.test:emulator: cd .. && scripts/emulator.sh 'scripts/run-tests.sh --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=900000 firebase/store.test.ts firebase/errors.test.ts firebase/scoping.test.ts firebase/concurrency.test.ts functions/src/api.test.ts functions/src/reaper.test.ts'
